architect.songTitle: Here I Dreamt I Was an Architect
architect.line: But here I dreamt I was an architect
stanza: And I am nothing of a builder
But here I dreamt I was an architect
To keep you home, to keep you safe
But the angles and the corners
Even though my work is unparalleled
This structure fell about our feet
And we were free to go
Show me pictures that hang in your house
Pictures that hang in your mouth
I have nothing to pray to you now
Nothing to pray to you now
